senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; סָכַךְ I)web on the loom. Ohol. VIII, 4 מ׳ הפרוסה the spread web, i.e. the web hanging from the transverse beam (vestis pendens, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tela).
units: Kel. XXI, 1 נפש המ׳ the woof, opp. to שתי עומד the warp of the standing loom.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 38">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVIII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 733:1">Yalk. Ps. 733</cite> <he>אנו המ׳ וכ׳</he> we are the web, and Thou the weaver; a. e.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:9">Ruth R. to II, 9</cite> (play on <he>וַיַּסֵּךְ</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 23:16">II Sam. XXIII, 16</cite>) <he>עשאה מ׳ וקבעה וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M01956"><he>מסכתא</he></cite>) he (David) constructed it and fixed it as a rule for future generations that the king forces the road &c. (v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:4">Snh. II, 4</cite>); Midr. Sam. ch. XX; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:5:4">Y. Snh. II, 20ᶜ</cite> top.
Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 25 אלו המ׳ דבר וכ׳ those are the systematic collections of Bar Ḳ. &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:12">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ששים מ׳</he> sixty Talmudic treatises [editions, however, count sixty-three]; Tanḥ. Korah 12; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:9:2">Cant. R. to VI, 9</cite> (not … <he>תיות</he>); a. fr.
